user.title: Set up NeuralBridge
user.description:
NeuralBridge provides priority-based AI agent routing for Home Assistant's Assist pipeline.

After setup, you can add AI agents with different priorities through the integration options.

**Priority System:**
- Routing Agents: Classify and route requests (added via "Add Routing Agent")
- Priority 1–100: Processing agents (lower numbers are tried first)

Click Submit to continue.

default_prompt.title: Configure Default Prompt
default_prompt.description: This prompt is sent to all **direct Ollama** (`AGENT_TYPE_OLLAMA`) agents that do not have their own per-agent system prompt configured. It does **not** apply to HA Conversation Agents (Gemini, HA Ollama integration, ChatGPT, etc.) — those agents use the system prompt configured within their own HA integration settings.

data_description.default_prompt: Instructions given to Ollama agents at the start of every conversation. Agents with their own system prompt will use that instead.

add_agent.title: Add Agent — Select Type
add_agent.description:
Choose the type of AI agent to add:

- **HA Intent Processor** — routes to `conversation.home_assistant` for device control (turn lights on/off, set thermostats, etc.)
- **HA Conversation Agent** — routes to any HA-registered LLM (HA Ollama integration, Gemini, ChatGPT…) for Q&A and general knowledge
- **Ollama (Direct Connection)** — direct HTTP to an Ollama server, bypassing HA — advanced use only
- **Web Search** — real-time internet search

configure_routing_agent.title: Configure Routing Agent
configure_routing_agent.description:
Select an installed Home Assistant conversation agent to act as the routing classifier. Only one routing agent is allowed.

{routing_agent_info}

data_description.agent_name: A friendly name for the routing agent (e.g. 'Router')
data_description.enabled: Toggle to enable or disable the routing agent without removing it
data_description.entity_id: Select any installed Home Assistant conversation agent to use as the router (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
data_description.timeout: Maximum time to wait for a routing decision (keep short to avoid stalling the pipeline)
data_description.router_log_level: Controls how much routing detail is written to the Home Assistant log
data_description.router_custom_prompt: Override the built-in JSON classification prompt. Leave blank to use the default prompt. Must instruct the agent to return JSON with "local_ha" (bool) and "complexity" (0–100) fields.
data_description.router_fallback: What to do when the routing agent errors, times out, or returns an unparseable response
data_description.strategy_reasoning: Agent selection strategy when the request requires multi-step reasoning. 'Default' uses benchmark scores; 'Fastest' picks the lowest-latency agent; 'Most capable' picks the highest-scoring agent; 'Local only' restricts to Ollama or LOCAL_HA agents.
data_description.strategy_instruction_following: Agent selection strategy when the request requires following precise instructions or formatting rules.
data_description.strategy_smart_home_intent: Agent selection strategy when the request is a smart-home device control command.
data_description.strategy_factual: Agent selection strategy when the request asks for a factual answer.
data_description.strategy_memory: Agent selection strategy when the request requires remembering context from earlier in the conversation.
data_description.delete_agent: Check this box and submit to permanently delete the routing agent (you will be asked to confirm)

advanced_settings.title: Advanced Settings
advanced_settings.description: Configure global NeuralBridge settings including home control and response caching.

data_description.enable_home_control: Allow NeuralBridge to control Home Assistant devices. When enabled, the Assist UI shows 'This assistant can control your home'. Add a Home Assistant sub-agent at a low priority number to handle device commands, with LLM agents at higher priorities for general questions.
data_description.force_response_language: When enabled, Ollama agents are instructed to respond in the same language the user is speaking (e.g. speak French → agent replies in French). Disable this to let the model respond in its default trained language.
data_description.split_compound_commands: When enabled, compound voice commands containing conjunctions ("and", "then", "also", "after that") are split into individual commands, each processed by the Local HA agent independently. Only applies when a Local HA agent is present in the pipeline.
data_description.response_cache_enabled: Cache agent responses to avoid repeated calls for identical inputs.
data_description.response_cache_ttl: How long (in seconds) a cached response remains valid before expiring.
data_description.purge_cache_now: Immediately discard all currently cached responses. Useful after changing agent configurations.
data_description.response_cache_semantic: When enabled, paraphrase variants of the same question (e.g. 'What is the weather?' and 'How is the weather today?') share the same cache entry.
data_description.semantic_cache_ttl: How long (in seconds) a semantically-keyed cache entry remains valid. Should be shorter than the exact TTL due to the looser key matching.
data_description.benchmark_warm_up_delay: How long (in seconds) NeuralBridge waits after startup before running the first benchmark probe. Increase this value on slow hardware to allow Ollama to fully load its models.

data_description.guard_rail_enabled: Enable hybrid rule-based and AI content filtering on agent responses
data_description.guard_rail_action: What to do when the guard rail flags a response as unsafe
data_description.guard_rail_ai_threshold: Confidence threshold below which AI checking is triggered (0.5 = check often, 1.0 = rules only)

data_description.high_stakes_enabled: When enabled, actions targeting the selected domains require explicit confirmation before execution
data_description.high_stakes_domains: HA domains whose actions will be intercepted and held pending confirmation
data_description.high_stakes_secret_enabled: Require the user to say a specific passphrase instead of a simple yes/no to confirm the action
data_description.high_stakes_secret: The passphrase the user must say to confirm a high-stakes action (leave blank to use yes/no)

run_benchmark.name: Run benchmark
run_benchmark.description: Triggers an immediate benchmark profiling run for the specified NeuralBridge agent. The agent must be of type Ollama or an existing HA conversation integration.

agent_id.name: Agent ID
agent_id.description: The internal UUID of the agent to benchmark (visible in the NeuralBridge sensor attributes).
